complete.description: Large scope served from a fresh snapshot: every keyword included.

live.description: Small scope computed for this request (at most LIVE_ROWS_BUDGET rows).

stale.description: The scope changed since the build: the previous figures, flagged, while a rebuild runs.

computing.description: No build holds this combination yet: a view job computes it; repeat the same GET to poll.

failed.description: The view job failed: answered once with 200, the next GET starts it again.

body.message: The view could not be computed; try again

partial.description: Live read cut by the time budget (safety net): honest coverage, keywords_truncated kept for one release.

page.description: The second page of keyword_trends (snapshot cursor); next_token is null on the last page.

cursor_expired.description: The token names a build that is gone (snapshot) or a keyword set that changed (keyword): restart the list without next_token.

body.error: The list changed since this page was read; start again from the first page
